criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Official Purdue GIS feature 85 identifies Benjamin Harrison Residence Hall at 107 Macarthur Drive; independent projection yields 28 vertices against 28 model base vertices with symmetric nearest-vertex error 0.000561 m.
criteria.limitation: The Purdue campus-map polygon is not a certified survey.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Manifest origin [-1110.0, -260.0] m was applied to the local GIS frame; the model base ring matches the full source vertex set and orientation. Evaluated asset bounds are [[-75.0, 75.0], [-85.0, 85.0], [-0.05999999865889549, 30.350000381469727]] m in local XYZ.
criteria.limitation: Project local meters-per-degree conversion is approximate; the footprint does not establish surveyed wall thickness or exact interior dimensions.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue OEP page documents three major wings, with north and south wings at 8 stories and center section at 2 stories; these relative masses are represented in the reopened scene and fresh preview.
criteria.limitation: No authoritative total elevation, floor-to-floor heights, floor datum, or roof-form source was found. Story count does not verify modeled 30.35 m total bounds or roof geometry.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Fresh renders show brick wall surfaces, repetitive window bands, an entrance canopy, signage, and a west solar screen. The official housing page only states two wings linked by common areas; its official hall-photo gallery feed confirms photo assets exist but supplied no facade descriptions or measured elevation. The award page cited by the builder lists a Harrison Hall employee and does not itself support an exterior entrance photograph.
criteria.limitation: Appearance alone is not evidence. No reviewed source image or dimensioned elevation verifies facade material/colors, window rhythm, screen geometry, sign, or entrance details.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Canonical builder ran on an isolated copy and generated fresh views; actual asset reopened in Blender 4.5.15 LTS. Export collection has 220 objects with exact manifest names, no cameras/lights in export, no unpacked external images or linked libraries; collection-only export probe was written (4195735 bytes) and reopened independently with the same 220 objects, no cameras/lights, and no external references. GIS, OEP, housing HTML, and gallery-feed JSON source snapshots are archived beside this report.
criteria.limitation: Opening the legacy scene emits Blender 4.5 warning that engine identifier BLENDER_EEVEE is unavailable; builder switches to BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT for renders. Scene still opens and previews render.

findings: Footprint/identity/manifest placement are independently verified against official Purdue GIS feature 85.

The canonical builder reruns successfully against the supplied seed in an isolated replica; its output hashes differ from the original because it saves refreshed metadata/render state, while the original asset, builder, and building evidence hashes were recorded unchanged.
Height and roof remain unverified. Facade/entrance details need a direct source-image comparison or dimensioned elevation before those points can be awarded.
The builder evidence record overstates the award page as supporting an entrance photograph; the saved award page is a winner-list and does not establish a facade image.
